basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon, with a penchant for immersive storytelling and world-building in video games. I enjoy exploring alternative history and speculative scenarios, which often fuels my design projects. I'm married, and we have a cat named Luna. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work and spend weekends delving into new games or sketching ideas for my next project. While I appreciate a good discussion, I dislike overly aggressive debates or trolling. My side hustle involves creating digital art inspired by video games and alternative historical settings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, particularly focusing on digital art and illustrations. I've been self-taught, with a background in fine arts, and have developed my skills through years of practice and online tutorials. My fascination with alternative history and narrative-driven games has expanded my knowledge in speculative fiction and storytelling.
